_about: Your group (squad.py): what you do with them, how it reads, and their group chat (which never needs anything from you). {group} is the group's name (the boys, the girls, the crew), {a} and {b} two of them, {host} whose house.

game.label: Hop on the game with {group}
lines: You hopped on with {group}. {a} carried, {b} rage-quit twice, and nobody went to bed on time.
Three hours online with {group}. You lost more than you won and it didn't matter at all.
Party chat with {group} until way too late. {a} finally won one and wouldn't shut up about it.
You got on with {group}. Half the time was the game, half was {b} telling a story with no ending.

park.label: Park with {group}
lines: You and {group} ran pickup at the park until it was too dark to see the ball.
{group} took over half the field at the park. {a} talked trash the whole time.
Park with {group}. Mostly sitting on the bleachers. Some actual playing. Perfect afternoon.

hoops.label: Shoot around with {group}
lines: Shooting around with {group} at the courts. {a} hit one from half court and has not stopped talking about it.
Twenty-one with {group} until the streetlights came on. {b} won and called it "easy".

food.label: Food run with {group}
lines: Food run with {group}. {a} ordered way too much and {b} ate half of it.
You and {group} split three orders of fries and argued about absolutely everything.
Late food with {group}. The waitress knows your order now. That's a milestone.

movie.label: Movie night at {host}'s
lines: Movie night at {host}'s. {a} fell asleep in the first twenty minutes and missed everything.
Movie night with {group}. Nobody watched the movie. Everybody had a great time.

beach.label: Beach day with {group}
lines: Beach day with {group}. Sunburns all around. {a} swears they put sunscreen on. They did not.
You and {group} spent the whole day at Jacobs Beach and came home exhausted and happy.

study.label: Homework on FaceTime with {group}
lines: Homework on FaceTime with {group}. Maybe forty percent homework. {a} did a bit for an hour.
You got your homework done on FaceTime with {group}. Mostly. {b} was a real help, somehow.

movie: {host} said we can do movies tonight

after: {a} we need to talk about that
best night in a while honestly
